origin.description: Formed by the standing coordinator agent on its own initiative; the obligation is bound at formation

objective.goal: Formalize and machine-check the three lemmas of the published conjecture note; the swarm concludes ACHIEVED when every milestone is accepted.
successCriteria: Each lemma has an accepted milestone whose result hash is a proof artifact that the verifier contract checks

milestones.title: Lemma A
criteria: proof artifact checks under the pinned checker version

milestones.title: Lemma B
criteria: proof artifact checks under the pinned checker version

milestones.title: Lemma C
criteria: proof artifact checks under the pinned checker version

acceptance.description: A verifier contract that checks proof artifacts; no judgment

objective.amendmentRule: No amendment of the lemma statements; a changed conjecture requires a successor swarm. Text corrections are minor amendments.

phases.name: bidding
phases.description: Any eligible bidder joins and records a proof sketch for one or more lemmas as a contribution within the two-day input window. The evaluation chamber scores the sketches; a bidder whose eligibility lapses is challenged and suspended.
phases.contributions: Open: anyone may record, non-member records are flagged; a sketch is the SHA-256 of the artifact bundle.
phases.selection: The evaluation chamber, through the collective decision adapter holding the ADVANCE authority, carries the chosen bidders into execution, reassigning them to the worker role; everyone else exits NOT_CARRIED.

allocation.description: No payment in this phase; being carried over is the prize.

phases.name: execution
phases.description: Each carried worker owns one lemma; milestones are accepted by the verifier contract; the coordinator role is held by the swarm's standing coordinator agent.

allocation.description: One third of the swarm account's reward per accepted milestone, to the worker whose contribution hash the milestone result cites.

requires: trust assertion level >= 3 under the formal-methods scheme
trust assertion level >= 1 under the formal-methods scheme

roles.name: sai.role.worker
roles.description: Execution-phase lemma owner (carried bidders); admitted only through SELECT

requires: same as bidder; re-checked on challenge

resources.purpose: Pinned proof checker; the verifier contract checks artifacts produced by this version
The conjecture note whose lemmas are the milestones

ADVANCE.description: Collective: evaluation chamber 2-of-2 through the collective decision adapter; the chamber roster is snapshotted per decision

CONCLUDE.description: The verifier contract (acceptance authority) concludes when the third milestone is accepted; the coordinator may conclude FAILED or ABANDONED
